test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers is NOT a tributary of the Yamuna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Yamuna **travels through numerous states, including **Haryana**, **Uttar **Pradesh, **Uttarakhand**, and later **Delhi**.
 
• Along the journey, it encounters its **tributaries**, including **Tons**, Chambal, which is its longest tributary and has its own sizable basin, **Sindh**, the **Betwa**, and **Ken**.
 
• The river enters the state of **Himachal Pradesh **from Uttarakhand.
 
• Yamuna runs past **Paonta Sahib**, along the border of **Uttar Pradesh **and **Haryana** then leaves Haryana and continues to flow until it joins the **Ganges **at Sangam or Prayag in **Allahabad **(Uttar Pradesh).
 
• Between it and the Ganges in the Indo-Gangetic plain, it contributes to the formation of the extremely fertile alluvial Ganges-Yamuna Doab region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• One of the main rivers in Nepal and a left-bank tributary of the Ganges in India is the **Gandaki River**, sometimes referred to as the **Narayani **and the **Gandak**.
 
• **46,300 km² **(17,900 sq mi) make up its whole **catchment area**, the majority of which is in **Nepal**.
 
• It is renowned for having a deep canyon in the **Nepalese Himalayas**.
 
• The **Dhaulagiri**, **Manaslu**, and **Annapurna I** mountains, which are all over 8,000 meters (26,000 feet), are all found in the basin.
 
• The Gandaki basin's highest point is **Dhaulagiri**.
